name: getMSGraphServiceClient
description: Returns a client for the Microsoft Graph API. Requires the `msgraph` package, which can be installed with `cfpm`.

params.name: config
params.description: A struct of settings for the client.

coldfusion.notes: Listed by getFunctionList() in ColdFusion 2025+. No official documentation exists. The argument name and the `msgraph` package requirement were confirmed on CF2025.
